_comment: Floor layout (v0.5.4): where every ASSET and every ROBOT stands. assets: type = a key of asset_types.json; position [x, y] or [x, y, z] m; orientation_deg [roll, pitch, yaw]; optional scale, approach_side, usd, readings, primary. robots: id, model (go2 | spot | h1 | g1 | amr), mode (simulation | digital_twin), position [x, y] = home, yaw_deg = home heading, optional walking (true), connection, map_to_world, policy_path, env_yaml_path. Robots are added when the scene is LOADed and by LOAD FLOOR LAYOUT; ADD / REMOVE ROBOT and ADD / REMOVE ASSET update this file; SAVE FLOOR LAYOUT writes it (previous version kept as .bak).
